title: Decadent Chocolate Paella
description: A rich and indulgent dessert paella, perfect for chocolate lovers. This heavenly treat combines gooey chocolate with crunchy french cookies.

ingredients.name: Heavenly Chocolate
ingredients.notes: Dark chocolate for a deeper flavor

ingredients.name: Gooey Caramel
ingredients.notes: For an extra rich and sticky sauce

ingredients.name: French Cookies
ingredients.notes: Crunchy on the outside, chewy on the inside

instructions: In a medium saucepan, melt the heavenly chocolate over low heat.
Stir in the gooey caramel until well combined.
In a separate bowl, crush the french cookies into fine crumbs.
Add the crushed cookies to the melted chocolate mixture and stir until a dough forms.
Transfer the dough to a 20cm (8in) paella dish or skillet.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the edges are set and the center is slightly gooey.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Serve warm, garnished with additional crushed cookies if desired.
